CREATE TABLE diagnostic_snapshots (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	captured_by_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	captured_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(captured_by_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_diagnostic_snapshots_job_id ON diagnostic_snapshots (job_id)
CREATE TRIGGER snapshot_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON diagnostic_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Diagnostic snapshots are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER snapshot_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON diagnostic_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Diagnostic snapshots are immutable'); END
